svg.metadata: Malaysia country geometry assembled from GSHHS intermediate-resolution coastlines and the Basemap intermediate country-boundary dataset (WGS84); Malaysia–Thailand, Malaysia–Indonesia and Brunei boundaries used to isolate Malaysian territory; Penang and Langkawi retained as map-significant islands. Frame W 98.3 / E 120.2 / S 0.3 / N 7.6; longitude scaled by cos(3.95°) to match JOURNEY ATLAS runtime markers; neighboring countries omitted to match the country-only map language.
